Leo and Anna are preparing a report about the school library. Anna has practiced volleyball for three years and won a prize last term. Anna thanked Leo for the honest advice. The final exam is next Friday.

People around Anna often share different ideas about the school library. Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, learn ten words a day.
The school library looked quieter than usual that evening. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Anna keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. He writes a blog about cooking.

The experience taught Anna more than any book could. The classroom has become an important part of daily life. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. What's more, our tastes differ, but we are close friends.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Little by little, things began to change.
